sourceClause.title: Accepted outcome
sourceClause.text: **Requirement.** When the provider accepts a submission, one local transaction records the reviewed content and provider message ID as a timeline activity, completes the recommendation, sets the next action to awaiting response, moves the opportunity from NOW to NEXT, and creates one notification for the responsible operator. A replayed provider event repeats none of it. This clause governs a send linked to an open opportunity; a send with no linked open opportunity records the same timeline activity and notification and opens OUT-017's contact-level awaiting-response obligation instead of a queue move. **Acceptance.** 1. Accept an approved send, replay its provider response and inspect one timeline message, completed action, NEXT transition and notification.
